title: roemeria refracta subsp. occidentalis
intro: Roemeria refracta subsp. occidentalis, commonly known as Western Beech, is a plant species belonging to the Papaveraceae family, characterized by its unique appearance and medicinal properties. The plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including fever, inflammation, and respiratory problems, due to its potential health benefits. Roemeria refracta subsp. occidentalis is reported to exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its medicinal value.
